source.historical_availability: The named test existed before this qualification run.

cases.provider_identity: GeneratedHostApp Phoenix endpoint mounted at /lockspire; source-host integration test, not a package receipt.

input_reference.request: Authorization Code request for a registered https://client.example.com/callback URI using a trailing-slash mismatch; synthetic client and request values.

cases.run_reference: Local Mix ExUnit invocation at the implementation branch source SHA.
cases.auth_mode: public client with PKCE S256; invalid redirect is rejected before host authentication or redirect
cases.safe_condition: A redirect_uri differing by a trailing slash from the registered URI is invalid; the user agent remains on Lockspire's browser-safe error surface.

normative_references.section: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 incorporating errata set 2, 3.1.2.6
normative_references.basis: If the Redirection URI is invalid, the Authorization Server MUST NOT redirect the User Agent to that invalid URI.

support_reference.claim: Phase 37 strictness slice includes exact redirect_uri matching.

cases.observed_outcome: HTTP 400; response body says Authorization request rejected and redirect_uri must match a registered URI; no Location header.
cases.expected_outcome: The mismatched URI is rejected without redirecting the user agent to it.
cases.cause: The requested URI has a trailing slash absent from the client's registered redirect URI.

repro.test_name: exact redirect_uri mismatches stay on the browser-safe surface

external_run.reason: This is a repository-host integration test; no OIDF/FAPI or other external suite ran.

package_receipt.reason: This source-host test did not install or test a published package.

cases.disposition: qualified source-host behavior for this one redirect-mismatch case; no package or certification claim

exclusions: External OIDF/FAPI suites are supplemental and were not run for A171-001.
This case does not set or revise policy for valid redirect callbacks.
